title: Business registration with the Business Registration Service
title_sw: Usajili wa biashara kwa Huduma ya Usajili wa Biashara (BRS)
why: A registered business can open a business bank account and sign contracts in its own name, and many funders ask for it.
why_sw: Biashara iliyosajiliwa inaweza kufungua akaunti ya benki ya biashara na kutia sahihi mikataba kwa jina lake, na wafadhili wengi huiomba.
when_to_get_help: If you are choosing between a business name and a limited company, an accountant or lawyer can explain the difference.
when_to_get_help_sw: Ikiwa unachagua kati ya jina la biashara na kampuni yenye dhima ndogo, mhasibu au wakili anaweza kukueleza tofauti.

title: KRA PIN for the business
title_sw: KRA PIN ya biashara
why: The business needs its own PIN to pay tax, and funders and banks often ask for it.
why_sw: Biashara inahitaji PIN yake yenyewe ili kulipa kodi, na wafadhili na benki mara nyingi huiomba.

title: Tax compliance certificate
title_sw: Cheti cha kufuata sheria za kodi (Tax Compliance Certificate)
why: Some funders and tenders ask for proof that the business is up to date with its taxes.
why_sw: Baadhi ya wafadhili na zabuni huomba uthibitisho kwamba biashara imelipa kodi zake zote kwa wakati.

title: eTIMS invoicing
title_sw: Ankara kupitia eTIMS

title: County business permit
title_sw: Kibali cha biashara cha kaunti
why: Counties require a permit to trade from a premises, and it is renewed regularly.
why_sw: Kaunti zinahitaji kibali ili kufanya biashara kutoka kwenye eneo la biashara, na kibali hicho hufanywa upya mara kwa mara.

title: Employer registrations (NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy)
title_sw: Usajili kama mwajiri (NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy)
why: A business with employees has to register as an employer and make deductions for them.
why_sw: Biashara yenye wafanyakazi inapaswa kujisajili kama mwajiri na kuwakata makato yao.
when_to_get_help: An accountant can set up payroll deductions correctly.
when_to_get_help_sw: Mhasibu anaweza kuweka makato ya mishahara ipasavyo.

title: Data protection registration with the ODPC
title_sw: Usajili wa ulinzi wa data kwa ODPC
why: A business that collects or stores personal data may need to register as a data controller or processor.
why_sw: Biashara inayokusanya au kuhifadhi taarifa za watu binafsi huenda ikahitaji kujisajili kama mdhibiti au mchakataji wa data.
institution: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

title: Bank account in the business name
title_sw: Akaunti ya benki kwa jina la biashara
why: Keeps business money separate from personal money, and lenders ask for it.
why_sw: Hutenganisha pesa za biashara na pesa zako binafsi, na wakopeshaji huiomba.

title: Founders' or shareholders' agreement
title_sw: Makubaliano ya waanzilishi au ya wanahisa
why: Sets out who owns what and what happens if someone leaves.
why_sw: Yanaeleza nani anamiliki nini, na nini kitatokea mtu akiondoka.
when_to_get_help: A lawyer should draft or review this before anyone signs.
when_to_get_help_sw: Wakili anapaswa kuyaandaa au kuyapitia kabla mtu yeyote hajatia sahihi.

title: Equity split and vesting recorded
title_sw: Mgawanyo wa hisa na ratiba ya kuzipata (vesting) umerekodiwa

title: Company registered with BRS, if not yet a company
title_sw: Kampuni imesajiliwa na BRS, ikiwa bado si kampuni

title: Directors and shareholders updated with BRS
title_sw: Wakurugenzi na wanahisa wamesasishwa BRS

title: Beneficial ownership information filed
title_sw: Taarifa za wamiliki halisi (beneficial ownership) zimewasilishwa

title: Term sheet
title_sw: Hati ya masharti (term sheet)
why: Records the main terms both sides have agreed before the full agreement is drafted.
why_sw: Inarekodi masharti makuu ambayo pande zote mbili zimekubaliana kabla ya makubaliano kamili kuandikwa.
when_to_get_help: A lawyer should draft or review this before anyone signs.
when_to_get_help_sw: Wakili anapaswa kuiandaa au kuipitia kabla mtu yeyote hajatia sahihi.

title: Investment agreement or shareholders' agreement
title_sw: Makubaliano ya uwekezaji au ya wanahisa
when_to_get_help: A lawyer should draft or review this before anyone signs.
when_to_get_help_sw: Wakili anapaswa kuyaandaa au kuyapitia kabla mtu yeyote hajatia sahihi.

title: Share allotment and register updates with BRS
title_sw: Ugawaji wa hisa na kusasisha rejista BRS

title: Beneficial ownership update
title_sw: Kusasisha taarifa za wamiliki halisi (beneficial ownership)

title: Tax and stamp duty questions referred to an accountant
title_sw: Maswali ya kodi na ushuru wa stempu yamepelekwa kwa mhasibu
when_to_get_help: An accountant should advise on tax and stamp duty for this deal.
when_to_get_help_sw: Mhasibu anapaswa kushauri kuhusu kodi na ushuru wa stempu kwa mkataba huu.

title: Investor's own checks (KYC)
title_sw: Ukaguzi wa mwekezaji mwenyewe (KYC)

title: Engagement letter with scope and fees
title_sw: Barua ya makubaliano ya kazi, yenye wigo wa kazi na ada

title: Confidentiality agreement, where needed
title_sw: Makubaliano ya usiri, inapohitajika
